hints.content:
The notation $g(3)$ refers to the output of the function when the input is $x=3$. If the point $(3,b)$ is on the graph, then $g(3)=b$.

We should look for the point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $3$.

The point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $3$ is the point $(3,4)$.

**Therefore, $g(3)=4$.**
